title: The exchange mate transports higher-image raw classes
statement: In the commutative-square setting and with raw transport B defined in [def-kun-commutative-exchange-raw-pullback], let c_f(z) be the higher-direct-image section obtained by derived adjunction, zeroth homology, shift to degree q and evaluation at the represented identity [sbc-lem-higher-direct-image-presheaf]. Let E be degree-q derived exchange, including exact-inverse-image homology and single comparisons [def-kun-commutative-derived-exchange]. Then E(U′)(η_g(c_f(z)))=c_f′(B(z)), where η_g is the inverse-image adjunction unit on sections [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. This statement concerns raw derived-Hom classes; it uses no chart cohomology evaluation or inverse evaluation map.

proof.text: The bounded-below mate of the exact pullback square equals the specified derived base-change map: both have the same factorization with the derived unit on single objects. Apply shifted mate naturality to the raw class, the free represented source isomorphism and the target single comparison. The square comparison on singles is the single of the underived square comparison, so the resulting target morphism is exactly the raw transport.

Apply zeroth homology to the shifted mate equality. Exact inverse-image/homology naturality, its single identity and shift comparison identify the resulting degree-q morphism. Naturality of the zeroth homology of a single moves the represented source isomorphism to the front. The free represented Hom equivalence takes precomposition by the inverse free pullback isomorphism to the section unit for g; evaluate this equality at the represented identity.

theorem commutativeExchangeClassCompatibility
    {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) (U : Y.Etale)
    (z : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (((f)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj ((abelianComparisonFree Y).obj U)) ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)⟦(q : ℤ)⟧) :
    let E :=
      (((g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso
        (q : ℤ)).hom.app _ ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
        ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq).app
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F) ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f').map
            ((((g')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app F))
    E.hom.app (op (g.Etale.obj U))
      (((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).unit.app _).hom.app
        (op U) (abelianHigherDirectImageClass f q F U z)) =
      abelianHigherDirectImageClass f' q _ (g.Etale.obj U)
        (commutativeExchangeRawPullback sq F q U z)
